mapper.select: SELECT COLUMN_SEQ AS id, COLUMN_TITLE AS title, STATUS_CD AS statusCode, POSITION AS position FROM TG_BOARD_COLUMN WHERE BOARD_SEQ = #{boardId} ORDER BY POSITION, COLUMN_SEQ

SELECT c.CARD_SEQ AS id, c.COLUMN_SEQ AS columnId, c.CARD_TITLE AS title, c.CARD_DESC AS description, c.POSITION AS position, c.DUE_DATE AS dueDate FROM TG_CARD c JOIN TG_BOARD_COLUMN col ON col.COLUMN_SEQ = c.COLUMN_SEQ WHERE col.BOARD_SEQ = #{boardId} ORDER BY c.COLUMN_SEQ, c.POSITION, c.CARD_SEQ
